profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary:
I am a specialist in high scalability, real-time, distributed systems. I find fascinating the complex interactions that emerge from such ecosystems of microservices, and I thrive on the challenge of anticipating them. 
I've worked on most angles related to service reliability. From the design implementation and verification of robust, fault tolerant systems, to driving the organization towards mature processes and a culture of operational excellence.

My passion is to work on loosely defined problems, requiring to go beyond the conventional boundaries between product/engineering/data sciences.

I am a computer scientist with heavy mathematics and physics background and experience as technical-non technical liaison in multidisciplinary teams. My experience in statistical models, physics simulation, and robotics comes from a variety of projects I took over the years leveraging the benefit of applying computer sciences to other disciplines.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead organization-level reliability initiatives. Including defining incident, post incident, and proactive processes to define, quantify and improve on service quality.
• Developed and maintained multiple projects focused on workflow orchestration and encoding backends. 
• Contributed to the design and implementation of Conductor, a large-scale orchestration engine for asynchronous processing at Netflix.  
• Engineered Timestone, a low-latency distributed priority queue, crucial for encoding pipelines with extremely high reliability demands.  
• Created Hermes, a feature-rich framework enhancing developer productivity and supporting back-office workflows.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Data ingestion and normalization pipeline.
- Search and relevance services based on Elasticsearch.
- Founded the Developer Experience team, working on tooling and procedures to streamline the daily work of engineeres.
- Designed a Kubernetes based development workflow to provide ease of set up and isolation during daily development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed Cloud-to-device communication, management and administration services. Extensive evolution on API usability for multiple external groups with dissimilar needs (different platforms, languages and development cycles)
- Developed and validated security strategies for IoT devices, with special emphasis on user privacy.
- Telemetry gathering, processing and distribution for analytics, video overlays and customer support.
- Architected and supervise device design with respect to cloud interaction. Graceful degradation and prevention of DoS attacks was in the center of focus.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently working on personalized relevance for the news app Pulse. Two very active areas of development are the categorization of news into topical clusters, and the estimation of perceived quality of the article for a concrete member.

Previously worked horizontally across the Content team, on the development of new product features to cross-distribute multiple verticals.
Some challenges tackled during the project:
- Product development, migration strategies, and viral loops.
- Full stack development, and agile proof of concept releases.
- Real-time storage, analysis and distribution.
- Offline deep analysis and relevance model development.

Previously, I work on key technology upgrades for the Groups product, where the massive scale and heavy usage required careful treatment and working knowledge of distributed systems.

positions.title: Engineering Manager - Search Infrastructure
positions.description:
As a manager of the Search Infrastructure team, I oversaw a variety of mission critical projects, including:
- Growth. Starting with a team of seven, and working on both internal development and hiring, the team doubled it's size while maintaining ownership and agility.
- Operationalization. The team reduced dramatically user facing service degradations, through a combination of service design, automatic monitoring, and the evolution of operational practices.
- Performance. The development of Galene, a core search library replacing Lucene, included not only better integration with the Linkedin tooling, but also advanced features for query expense capping, and result approximation. These characteristics resulted in a significant reduction both in user perceived response time, and hardware footprint.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the search infrastructure team, I had the opportunity to dive into a variety of different problems including search, typeahead, cluster management, data processing pipelines, and content stores.

Key projects include:
SeaS: Designed, prototyped and develop a new self-served service to power all internal search use cases. The project included automatic hardware allocation, error detection and correction, pushing the limits of the internal tooling and deployment services, and exemplifying a general strategy for unattended operations that served as a model for other infrastructure groups in the company.

Recruiter search: complete re-architecture of the existing solution addressing fundamental performance and scalability limitation of the previous model. An integral project including problem analysis, architectural proposal, execution and migration for a service that is a key revenue channel for the company.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
IndexTank.com search-as-a-service model creates a number of unique challenges:
- Multi-tenancy, resource isolation, and performance monitoring.
- Automatic cluster expansion and reorganization.
- Data integrity and failure/disaster recovery.
- Real-time constraints.

At the same time my duties include product, giving technical talks, and acting as a technical liaison with our clients.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
Some of the projects I worked in are:
- a fully scalable, high performance, full-text search library in java.
- bewolf-style clustered applications.
- web crawlers.
- automatic document categorization and filtering.
- in house stress testing applications and load models.

positions.title: Teacher assistant (Ayudante de 1a, Area Sistemas.)
positions.description: I worked lecturing on problem resolution classes, giving support to students and correcting mid-terms for the following classes: computer organization 1, computer organization 2 and operating systems.

company.name: Depto. Computacion, Facultad de Ciencias Exactas y Naturales, Universidad de Buenos Aires

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working as an external contractor for Flaptor.
Development, deployment and ops. of a search cluster based on Hounder (http://code.google.com/p/hounder/, developed in house).
The complete system included several independent search clusters of 20 machines each.

positions.title: Statistical Analyst
positions.description:
Data Mining.
Active developement of medication consumption profiles to provide basic data for business planning.
Developement of automatic medication comsumption auditing algorithms.
Reseach on heuristic algorithms to detect fraud based on medication incompatibilities.
Database management in SQL Server.
